task: Define the pilot scope and acceptance boundary.
inputs: Business goal, candidate documents, and intended destination.
outputs: Pilot scope and acceptance criteria.
completion: Confirm document family, reviewer, destination, and test boundary.
scope: One scoped pilot.
direction: Record business intent and boundaries with the human owner.
guardrails: Separate pilot evidence from production readiness.
evidence: BID-01 story records the pilot scope and acceptance boundary.
comments: Pilot scope and acceptance boundary were recorded in the BID-01 story.
value: The team can align work with the intended business outcome.

task: Verify the cloud project and processing prerequisites.
inputs: Authorized project, intended region, access, and processor requirements.
outputs: Cloud prerequisites record.
completion: Confirm project, access, location compatibility, limits, and billing.
scope: One authorized pilot environment.
direction: Inspect the selected Cloud Storage and Document AI environment.
guardrails: Resolve billing and access before new processing.
evidence: BID-01 story records the pilot bucket and processor.
comments: Billing and credits were not independently verified.
value: Operators can identify missing access or billing prerequisites before processing.

task: Create or reuse the pilot storage bucket.
inputs: Authorized project, region, privacy, and retention requirements.
outputs: Private pilot bucket and configuration record.
completion: Read back the bucket location, access, retention, and intended project.
scope: One storage bucket for the pilot.
direction: Reuse a suitable bucket or create one after approval.
guardrails: Preserve access restrictions and avoid exposing sensitive identifiers.
evidence: The BID-01 story records a private pilot bucket.
comments: The handoff confirms the bucket existed; a full configuration readback is not recorded.
value: Operators have a private place to stage authorized documents.

task: Organize storage prefixes and stage authorized samples.
inputs: Authorized samples, source links, and storage access.
outputs: Staged files and provenance manifest.
completion: Match staged objects to their manifest entries and confirm intended access.
scope: Pilot sample staging and reusable prefix conventions.
direction: Choose relevant input, review, output, and archive prefixes; stage the approved sample set.
guardrails: Keep provenance; naming alone does not enforce access or classification.
evidence: Pilot staging readback matched staged samples to the provenance manifest.
comments: Pilot samples were staged. The broader folder convention remains proposed.
value: Reviewers can find staged samples and trace their origin.

task: Apply and verify approved bucket labels and tags.
inputs: Pilot bucket, existing labels, effective tags, approved naming rules.
outputs: Verified labels, tag decision, before-and-after readback.
completion: Read back approved labels; log tag omission or verify effective tags and access.
scope: One pilot bucket; label and tag decision.
direction: Inspect labels and inherited tags. Propose env=pilot, story=bid-01, workload=bid-intake, owner=approved-team. Apply approved values only.
guardrails: Preserve labels and object metadata. Add tags only for approved policy or access.
comments: Neon design proposal; no approvals, applications, or timing measured.
value: Operators can identify the pilot bucket’s owner and workload without tracing account history or asking another team.
metric: Minimize time to find bucket owner and workload. Proposed target: ≤2 minutes.

task: Record and verify document object metadata.
inputs: Staged files and approved provenance keys.
outputs: Per-object metadata and a provenance manifest.
completion: Read back object metadata and reconcile it with the manifest.
scope: Pilot document provenance.
direction: Record approved source identifiers, timestamps, and object versions as applicable.
guardrails: Keep sensitive information out of metadata and shared inventories.
evidence: Pilot metadata readback verified the approved provenance fields on 20 objects.
comments: Metadata readback was verified for 20 pilot objects.
value: Reviewers can trace each document back to its source.
reuseOpportunity: Use S-20 storage template for provenance metadata; saves duplicate field design.

task: Review document classifications and routing rules.
inputs: Representative samples and proposed document categories.
outputs: Reviewed category rules and an unknown-document route.
completion: Confirm category boundaries and handling for ambiguous documents.
scope: Pilot document classification decisions.
direction: Compare candidate categories with the source documents.
guardrails: Route uncertain cases for review; validate automation separately.
evidence: Pilot classifier had Erie Invitation to Bid and Other labels. One sample was suggested as Erie.
comments: Human confirmation, a second sample, and formal prediction testing remain open. Automated routing was not validated.
value: Operators can identify document families and route uncertain cases for review.
reuseOpportunity: Classifier routing template: saves repeated unknown-category and confidence-rule design after validation.

task: Select the fields applicable to the document family.
inputs: Representative sample, candidate schema, and desired data fields.
outputs: Reviewed field selection and exclusions.
completion: Check chosen fields, types, requiredness, and repeated structures against the source.
scope: Fields for the selected pilot document family.
direction: Review schema suggestions; refine relevant fields and disable unrelated fields.
guardrails: Keep source evidence and validate generated suggestions before use.
evidence: BID-01 transcript: schema generation rejected the full PDF at its 15-page limit; page one yielded a draft.
comments: Exhibits were disabled initially; submission instructions were disabled later. The subsequent full-document run returned both item groups.
value: Reviewers can focus extraction on the fields the business needs.
reuseOpportunity: Use S-05 configuration workbook to save repeated field-definition setup.

task: Configure the baseline extractor from the selected fields.
inputs: Selected fields, authorized processor, and pilot document family.
outputs: Versioned baseline extractor configuration.
completion: Verify active fields and processor version before the baseline run in S-01.
scope: Baseline processor and schema only.
direction: Apply the reviewed schema and record the effective processor version.
guardrails: Preserve prior settings and distinguish configuration from extraction quality.
evidence: Pilot extractor was enabled, the one-page schema was applied, and a one-page test returned fields.
comments: The later run used a zero-training version. Its description prompt included the full cell and leading code.
value: Operators can use a defined schema for a repeatable extraction test.
reuseOpportunity: Use S-05 configuration workbook to save repeated extractor schema setup.

task: Recover an edited pilot annotation from the original OCR.
inputs: Pilot annotation, source page, and existing sibling labels.
outputs: Fresh source-grounded annotation and pilot readback record.
completion: Verify the new label contains the full selected OCR span and the separate code remains under the same item.
scope: One multiline item description in the pilot.
direction: Replace the edited child with a fresh full-cell selection and retain the separate code label.
guardrails: Leave detected OCR text intact. Treat overlap compatibility as a separate check.
comments: Selected annotations were saved in Workbench. Dataset-wide labeling and overlap verification remain separate; see S-11 and S-26.
evidence: Pilot label readback showed the original OCR span and separate code on the same saved item.
value: Reviewers retain a source-grounded annotation for later verification.

task: Run the baseline extraction on a representative pilot document.
evidence: Full 22-page zero-training extraction returned raw JSON for source comparison.
inputs: Selected pilot document and baseline extractor schema.
outputs: Raw extraction JSON.
completion: Verify the run covered the entire pilot document and retained the raw extraction JSON.
comments: Pilot: Erie 2025 public 22-page PDF. QA-02 separately checks traceable results or errors per PDF and verifies items, quantities, and units against source pages.
direction: Run the baseline extractor. Keep the raw JSON and source-page references for later comparison.
scope: One representative pilot document, processed end to end with the baseline schema.
guardrails: Record the actual output. Validate extraction quality separately against the source.
value: Reviewers can inspect a complete baseline extraction against the source.

task: Retest revised field descriptions on the same pilot document.
evidence: A focused zero-training retest processed all 22 pages after changing only the payment-terms description.
inputs: Original pilot document, baseline extraction, and revised field descriptions.
outputs: Retest JSON and comparison for each changed field.
completion: Verify the same document and revised descriptions were used. Compare each changed field against the baseline and source.
comments: Erie: narrowed only payment_terms. Page 4 was blank; the retest returned “quote net.” from page 6. Recheck in S-07; refine in S-08.
scope: One or more fields with baseline extraction issues.
direction: Record the changes, rerun the document, and verify each changed field against its source.
guardrails: Retain the unexpected result as evidence. Flag unsupported values before using them.
value: Reviewers see whether payment extraction improved.

task: Review extractor fields and propose prompt improvements.
evidence: Antigravity reviewed the workbook and public PDF and proposed descriptions for 28 active fields.
inputs: Approved workbook, public source PDF and Google documentation
outputs: Field-level prompt suggestions.
completion: Suggestions returned; they are proposals and require source-based testing.
scope: Active extractor fields and their source context in the pilot document.
direction: Compare workbook configuration with document context and official Google documentation.
guardrails: Treat suggestions as untested; do not invent document values.
value: Reviewers get field-specific prompt suggestions grounded in the source.
comments: Medium reasoning observed for response.

task: Select candidate field descriptions for testing.
evidence: 28 active-field candidates saved locally; awaiting extraction tests and any refinement.
inputs: Proposed field descriptions and source context.
outputs: JSON file of selected prompt candidates.
completion: Verify that each selected description is traceable to an active field and marked untested.
scope: Existing active fields selected for the pilot.
direction: Refine suggested descriptions to reduce overfitting and preserve field definitions.
guardrails: Do not rename fields, change occurrence settings, enable disabled fields or assume accuracy.
value: Operators get a consistent set of candidate descriptions to test.
comments: Medium reasoning observed when requested.

task: Record selected prompts in the configuration workbook, keeping current and proposed descriptions distinguishable.
evidence: All 28 candidates added to the draft workbook; original descriptions and disabled fields preserved. The published workbook has not yet been updated.
inputs: Current configuration workbook and selected candidate descriptions.
outputs: Draft configuration workbook with current descriptions, proposed descriptions, and validation status.
completion: Verify that each selected proposal is alongside its current description, labeled untested, and that disabled fields are unchanged.
scope: Record candidate prompts alongside existing field descriptions in the draft workbook.
direction: Populate the proposed-prompt and status columns for each active field.
guardrails: Keep original descriptions and disabled fields unchanged; label candidates untested.
comments: Workbook changes are local. Exact GPT-6 variant unconfirmed.
value: Reviewers can compare current and proposed prompts.

task: Apply the selected prompts to a suitable Document AI test version.
inputs: S-05 workbook snapshot, selected prompts, baseline schema, and test processor version.
outputs: Test version with verified prompt snapshot
completion: Read back test settings and confirm they match the selected workbook prompts.
direction: Resolve unclear workbook fields with a reviewer before applying selected prompts.
scope: Apply selected prompts to a Document AI pilot test version.
guardrails: Preserve prior versions and evidence; do not train or write Salesforce records.
comments: Proposed model for applying and verifying configuration; exact workbook-to-config parity and final assignment remain pending.
value: Operators can test the selected prompts in an identifiable processor version.
reuseOpportunity: Use S-05 configuration workbook to avoid reassembling selected field prompts.

task: Rerun the pilot document and compare results with the baseline and source.
evidence: Full zero-training run completed. Retest returned page 6 policy for blank page 4 payment terms; item groups intact.
inputs: Same pilot document, verified test version, baseline JSON.
outputs: New raw JSON and source comparison.
completion: Compare required fields, item rows, and source pages; log missing, conflicting, or unsupported values.
scope: One pilot document using the updated test version.
direction: Run verified test version, keep JSON, compare values and page anchors.
guardrails: Use authorized PDF only; flag unsupported, missing, or conflicting values.
comments: Later payment_terms retest did not reverify other fields; remaining field and source checks stay open.
value: Reviewers can identify improvements and remaining extraction errors.
reuseOpportunity: Source-comparison template: saves rebuilding expected, observed, page-reference, and discrepancy tables.

task: Revise targeted prompts when the pilot retest exposes failures.
inputs: Specific failed fields, observed output and source evidence
outputs: Targeted revised prompts
completion: Compare revised results with source. Record the changed prompt, version, and outcome for each attempt.
scope: Refine specific prompts that fail the bounded single-document test.
direction: Use the observed failure to make one targeted change before each retest. Reuse the same authorized PDF.
guardrails: Proposed cap: two retests within approved spend. Stop sooner if the check passes or no new fix is worth testing. Retain evidence.
comments: Proposed model for targeted prompt refinement in the existing Antigravity discussion.
value: Operators can address observed failures with targeted prompt refinements.

task: Review source disagreements and extraction quality with the user.
inputs: Original PDF, comparison and conflicting extractions
outputs: Recorded human review decisions
completion: Reviewer identifies correct source values and resolves or records remaining uncertainty.
direction: Neither model result is automatically accepted as ground truth.
scope: Resolve discrepancies between source evidence and extracted values.
guardrails: Keep original evidence; neither model is ground truth; block unsupported time zones or p6 policy in RFQ fields.
comments: Human sign-off on source disagreements remains pending.
value: Sales reviewers can resolve conflicting facts before relying on them.

task: Prepare training examples and independent holdout examples.
inputs: Candidate documents, provenance, and proposed schema.
outputs: Training and independent holdout inventory
completion: Confirm document identities, layouts, duplicates, access, source provenance and separate assignments.
scope: Select examples that represent the intended document population and reserve independent holdouts.
direction: Inventory provenance, document identity, layout, duplicates and train/test assignments.
guardrails: Keep holdouts independent; do not process further PDFs contrary to any active approval restriction.
comments: Proposed model for inventory and evidence reconciliation; final assignment remains pending.
value: Evaluators can test performance on documents separate from training examples.
reuseOpportunity: Dataset split checklist: saves repeating provenance, duplicate, and holdout checks.

task: Verify the overlapping child annotations before reuse.
inputs: Pilot annotations from S-25 and the applicable processor configuration.
outputs: Compatibility check and proceed-or-rework decision.
completion: Reopen the saved item and verify both children survive under one parent. Record separate evaluation results when available.
scope: Full-cell description and overlapping product-code child.
direction: Read back both labels and anchors. Check processor support before counting the sample as training-ready.
guardrails: Visible overlap alone does not prove training or evaluation compatibility.
comments: Gemini Neon identified distinct checks for persistence and extraction. Both need direct evidence.
value: Operators can determine whether overlapping item annotations are usable.

task: Label and verify the selected dataset examples.
inputs: Selected documents and schema
outputs: Reviewed labeled examples
completion: Check source spans, all relevant item rows, blank fields and dataset assignment.
scope: Label selected examples for relevant fields and requested-item rows.
direction: Assign source-grounded annotations and verify completeness and dataset split.
guardrails: Preserve OCR text; do not fabricate blank values or mark incomplete labels as reviewed.
comments: The pilot annotation recovery and save happened in S-25. Dataset-wide labeling remains open, after the overlap check in S-26.
value: Model evaluators get source-checked examples for training and testing.
reuseOpportunity: Use S-10 dataset checklist to save repeating labeling completeness checks.

task: Train or configure an appropriate processor version.
inputs: Reviewed training/test sets; verified model requirements and billing
outputs: Identified processor version
completion: Training or configuration completes and version, dataset counts and cost evidence are recorded.
scope: Create an appropriate trained or configured processor version.
direction: Verify model-specific dataset requirements, permissions and billing; record the actual version.
guardrails: Respect approved spend and access; no production writes or unsupported training claims.
comments: The full-document foundation-model run used zero training. Custom training remains open.
value: Operators get an identifiable processor version configured for evaluation.

task: Evaluate on held-out labeled examples, including missing and populated fields.
inputs: Processor version; held-out labeled documents with populated and missing fields
outputs: Field-level evaluation and error evidence
completion: Report supported precision/recall, missed items and false positives; do not infer success for unscored fields.
scope: Evaluate the chosen version on independent labeled documents.
direction: Check expected fields and item rows against source pages. Flag false fields sourced from excluded sections and table notes that are not products.
guardrails: Do not claim success for unscored fields or extrapolate from the training set.
comments: The earlier held-out Form Parser and mapper check was separate. Custom Extractor held-out evaluation has not run.
value: Reviewers can assess errors on independent examples before relying on results.
reuseOpportunity: S-07 comparison template saves evaluation setup.

task: Validate downstream cleanup of a leading item code.
inputs: Extraction with separate raw description and source code, plus matching and nonmatching test fixtures.
outputs: Clean display description and validation results.
completion: Remove the exact leading code only when it matches the separate field. Verify unmatched text and raw evidence stay intact.
scope: Optional downstream normalization after overlap validation.
direction: Test deterministic prefix removal on matching, nonmatching, and missing code cases.
guardrails: Preserve raw OCR and page provenance. Route ambiguous cases for review.
comments: Gemini Neon suggested downstream cleanup; no workflow or tool is selected.
value: Reviewers can see clean item descriptions while retaining source text.
reuseOpportunity: Code-prefix cleanup fixture: saves rebuilding the raw-versus-cleaned comparison after validation.

task: Record reproducible steps and decisions in the reusable workflow guide.
inputs: Observed setup steps, decisions, failures and verified results
outputs: Reusable Markdown guide for the validated document-processing workflow.
completion: Guide provides generic steps for storage, schema, labeling, review and evaluation; distinguish untested guidance.
scope: Document the reusable document-processing workflow for humans and agents.
direction: Capture verified navigation, decisions, exceptions and links while marking untested steps.
guardrails: Use generic names; omit credentials, private links and claims of unverified success.
comments: A local workflow guide draft exists. Proposed model for documenting verified workflow steps; final assignment remains pending.
value: Future teams can repeat the verified workflow and understand its limits.
reuseOpportunity: Workflow guide saves repeated process discovery.

task: Update the GitHub workbook and story references when the reviewed changes are ready.
inputs: Reviewed workbook changes, current branch state and publication permissions
outputs: Sanitized workbook, synthetic sample, matching expected JSON, and verified story links.
completion: Verify the workbook, sample, and expected JSON agree. Check published files and links for restricted material.
direction: Compare with prior publication, remove pilot data, and publish reviewed files through the approved workflow.
scope: Publish reviewed workbook changes and reconcile the associated story references.
guardrails: Preserve concurrent edits and existing criteria; exclude private chats, secrets and restricted evidence.
comments: The published workbook still contains the earlier configuration. The enhanced workbook remains a local draft. Planned model assignment is pending.
value: Reviewers can find the current reusable configuration and story references.

task: Verify independent read-only platform access and billing prerequisites.
outputs: Record the authorized target identities and availability for each connection.
completion: Separately verify Salesforce CLI and Headless 360 MCP, plus Google Cloud project, storage, Document AI and billing.
comments: Storage and processor access, Salesforce CLI and pilot operator access observed. MCP and billing verification remain open.

task: Prepare a bounded scenario batch and validate source checks.
outputs: Fixture manifest, documentation map and source expectations.
completion: Manually verify a known case and a missing or conflicting case against independent source evidence.
comments: Historical one-file and local synthetic checks are partial. The complete scenario batch and fixture expectations are pending.

task: Design the Solicitation Document child and reviewer access.
outputs: Reviewed child schema, optional lookup, document access and review design.
completion: Verify the design against test-org metadata, permissions, signed link restrictions, replay handling and reviewer workflow.
comments: Lookup and layout were observed. Child record, signed link and separate reviewer verification are pending.

task: Run the authorized bounded intake pilot and verify test drafts.
outputs: Batch evidence and test drafts available for scenario review.
completion: Verify draft intake, document history, replay, amendment review and Opportunity linking on the tested build.
comments: Requires reviewed intake implementation and authorized processing and test writes.

task: Independently inspect pilot scenarios and record the human acceptance decision.
outputs: Surface-specific scenario results and recorded acceptance decision.
completion: Review scenario evidence and gaps against all five criteria. Record who accepted what, or leave acceptance pending.
comments: Independent reviewer assignment and acceptance are pending.
